findings.claim: Shared capacity counts durable records with attributes&0x38 across all players; pawn action refuses at>=6.
Menu includes clear-flag records without positive-quantity check, or flagged records with quantity>1; selected flagged record always refused.
Building used Buy list scans all players for bit0x20, sets fixed redemptionPrice controls, and ORs0x100 into each source record immediately.
Successful used purchase clears source0x38, removes empty source group, then calls buyer.hasType(index,1); existing group is incremented without copying source price/attributes.
Without buyer same-type group, zero source is moved as quantity1; nonzero source remains and a quantity1 clone is added.
